system_metadata.description: Concrete AI-agent workflows for workbook inspection, validation, repair, and reporting.

preconditions: Workbook file is available; no edits have been made.
inspection_steps: list sheets, hidden sheets, tables, named ranges, external links, pivots, charts, formulas, Python cells

human_review_triggers: hidden sheets, external links, Python cells, macros, upload/output tabs
